description: Source code for a socket server implementation handling TCP connections, message sending/receiving, and threading, with classes Response and SocketServer.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response message with channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP socket server with methods to open, run, send messages, and handle client connections.

methods.name: Response()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing channel_id to 0 and json to empty.

methods.name: Response(uint32_t, const string&)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with specific channel ID and JSON string.

methods.name: Open(const string&, int, const function<void (const Response&)>&)
methods.description: Sets up and starts listening on specified address and port.

methods.name: RunThread()
methods.description: Creates a thread to run the server loop.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Main server loop accepting connections and reading responses.

methods.name: ReadExact(uint8_t*, int)
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the client socket.

methods.name: SendInvoke(uint32_t, const string&, const string&)
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with channel ID, token, and JSON payload.

methods.name: SendAttach(uint32_t, bool)
methods.description: Sends an attach command with channel ID and attach flag.

methods.name: SendExit()
methods.description: Sends an exit command to disconnect client.

methods.name: ReadResponse(Response&)
methods.description: Reads a response message from the client.
